_comment: LLM extraction targets — free-text policy pages with no machine-readable feed (e.g. China MEE, India CPCB). Gated behind RUN_LLM_EXTRACT=1 + OPENAI_API_KEY (GitHub Actions secret). Each entry: {url, country (ISO-2), kind: 'pdf'|'html', note}. Deterministic countryCode/region come from the entry, not the LLM. All URLs verified reachable via the collector's urllib fetch path.

sources.note: China Air Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan (APPCAP, 2013) — UN ESCAP Asia Pacific Energy Portal
India National Clean Air Programme (NCAP, 2019) — official CPCB/PRANA report (PDF), exercises the pdf_extract path
